thread:
Maya Chen: Quick check — I pushed a first-pass one-pager for enterprise buyers focused on Security + SLAs + deployment modes. doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/enterprise-onepager-draft
Ben Ortiz: On it. Can we make the header 'How to choose a deployment' — sales wants decision guidance, not just bullets.
Jon Patel: +1. Also need one short benchmark callout comparing latency/cost for hosted vs dedicated vs private (3 lines).
Maya Chen: Added a 3-line benchmark summary (p95 latency / $/1k tokens). Placed it under 'What to expect'.
Tara Li: For the webinar blurb, let's promise a 20-minute demo and a 10-minute field Q&A for security/compliance questions. That usually drives leads.
Maya Chen: Noted. Draft webinar CTA: "Join our field briefing: Secure inference at scale — SLA patterns & deployment tradeoffs." Would you shorten?
Ben Ortiz: Shorten to: "Secure inference at scale: SLAs, Deployments, Benchmarks". Keep the CTA button 'Register — Seats limited'.
Ali R.: Routing note — any inbound from gov/healthcare vertical should go to enterprise-sales + Tara for compliance triage. Can we add explicit routing rules?
Maya Chen: Drafted routing snippet for ops:
```
if lead.vertical in ["healthcare","gov"] or lead.compliance == "high":
  route -> "enterprise-sales@redwood.io", "tara.li@redwood.ai"
else if lead.usage_estimate > 100000:
  route -> "dedicated-sales@redwood.ai"
else:
  route -> "selfserve-growth@redwood.ai"
```
Jon Patel: Love the snippet. Can we add a field flag for 'needs-private-deploy' so AE knows to ask about VPC/on-prem?
Maya Chen: Yup added `lead.needs_private = true` branch with a note to request infra contact.
Field Ops: FYI, please attach the one-pager PDF for field enablement. We prefer a one-page PDF + 1 slide cheat-sheet.
Maya Chen: Uploaded PDF + cheat-sheet to the folder and linked in the doc. https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/enterprise-onepager-v1.pdf
Ben Ortiz: Messaging iteration: we should A/B test two subject lines in the webinar invite — (A) "Secure inference at scale" and (B) "SLA & deploy patterns for regulated apps". Field prefers A, sales prefers B.
Tara Li: Run A/B across two equal cohorts from the enterprise list, measure CTR and MQL rate after 7 days. Report back.
ops-bot: Webinar event created: 2025-11-18 16:00 UTC. Registration page: https://events.redwood.ai/secure-inference-webinar
Ali R.: Quick compliance blurb for the one-pager: short bullets on KMS/HSM support, audit logs, VPC peering, SOC2. Keep to 3 bullets max.
Maya Chen: Done. Also added a 'SLA band' table (bronze/silver/gold) with expected uptime and latency SLOs.
Jon Patel: Can you surface the most conservative p95 numbers in the one-pager (so field doesn't oversell)? Put conservative numbers in parentheses.
Maya Chen: Updated numbers to conservative p95 in parens.
Tara Li: For sales enablement, create 3 quick objection responses: cost vs cloud provider, control for sensitive data, fallback if capacity hit. One-liners.
Maya Chen: Added the objection response section at bottom. Examples:
- Cost: "We provide batching + caching recommendations to reduce unit cost without changing model quality."
- Data control: "Private deployments isolate data; we integrate with your KMS and on-prem keys."
- Capacity: "Automatic fallback policies and compatible model variants keep apps online during spikes."
Ben Ortiz: Looks great. Final ask: can design create a hero image that shows "Hosted — Dedicated — Private" icons in one row? Pinged design.
Maya Chen: Pinged @design. ETA from design: 48 hours.
Field Ops: Once design is in, we'll produce 1-page PDF + 1-slide cheat + 3-email nurture sequence for MQLs.
Maya Chen: Plan: finalize copy by EOD tomorrow, send to design, set webinar invite A/B tomorrow morning. Anyone object?
Jon Patel: No objections.
Ben Ortiz: Good to go.
Tara Li: Thanks everyone :rocket:
Maya Chen: ✅ Closing and locking doc for final review.
ops-bot: thread archived for marketing collateral workflows.
